seeds.title: Catchment Under Pressure — Runoff Lab
seeds.summary: Predict and model how rainfall, hard surfaces and drainage combine to produce surface-water accumulation.
seeds.subject: humanities
seeds.learningObjective: Explain how rainfall intensity, impermeable cover and drainage capacity affect surface-water accumulation.
seeds.descriptor: A live runoff model with three controls, calculated readouts and an inline one-hour graph.

seeds.title: Cool Box Fair-Test Lab — Variable Planner
seeds.summary: Classify variables, diagnose confounds and sequence a repaired insulation test.
seeds.subject: science
seeds.learningObjective: Identify independent, dependent and controlled variables and improve a method to test one factor fairly.
seeds.descriptor: A three-stage investigation planner using selects, checks and touch-friendly reorder controls.

seeds.title: Cut extra words
seeds.summary: Edit a school canteen rule by removing waffle while keeping its action, place, timing and reason.
seeds.subject: english
seeds.learningObjective: Edit a paragraph for concision without removing the facts needed to understand its rule and reason.
seeds.descriptor: A single tappable paragraph with a live word count and feedback about load-bearing facts.

seeds.title: Rectangles with the Same Perimeter — Dimension Explorer
seeds.summary: Change an even perimeter and inspect whole-number width-length pairs on a live graph.
seeds.subject: mathematics
seeds.learningObjective: Generate rectangles with the same perimeter and reason about width and length.
seeds.descriptor: An amber dimension explorer coupling a perimeter stepper to an inline SVG plot.

seeds.title: Fraction Equivalence Detective — Three Clues
seeds.summary: Compare, explain and represent equivalent fractions through three diagnostic prompts.
seeds.subject: mathematics
seeds.learningObjective: Recognise equivalent fractions and explain why the same operation on both parts preserves value.
seeds.descriptor: A visual fraction bar and three misconception-focused checks with immediate feedback.

seeds.title: Linear Function Explorer — Gradient and Intercept
seeds.summary: Vary gradient and intercept and connect y = mx + c to a responsive line graph.
seeds.subject: mathematics
seeds.learningObjective: Explain how gradient and vertical intercept affect a straight-line graph.
seeds.descriptor: Two coefficient sliders update equation, point value and inline SVG graph together.

seeds.title: Market Street Field Notes — Evidence First
seeds.summary: Separate observations from interpretations and build a responsible evidence-led conclusion.
seeds.subject: humanities
seeds.learningObjective: Distinguish observation from interpretation and identify evidence needed to support a geographical claim.
seeds.descriptor: A compact field notebook combining classification, corroboration and conclusion ordering.

seeds.title: Mean and median
seeds.summary: Drag a score on a dot plot and see why one extreme value pulls the mean more than the median.
seeds.subject: mathematics
seeds.learningObjective: Compare how an extreme score affects the mean and median and explain the difference.
seeds.descriptor: A touch-first dot plot where moving scores changes mean and median markers live.

seeds.title: Build a Clear Explanation — Rain Paragraph
seeds.summary: Classify sentence roles and sequence a coherent explanation of rain formation.
seeds.subject: english
seeds.learningObjective: Organise an explanation using a topic sentence, ordered details and concluding link.
seeds.descriptor: A two-step paragraph builder preserving sentence roles and temporal logic.

seeds.title: Persuasive Language Lab — Reader Effects
seeds.summary: Identify inclusive language, concrete evidence and a rhetorical question and connect each to effect.
seeds.subject: english
seeds.learningObjective: Explain how evidence, rhetorical questions and inclusive language shape a reader's response.
seeds.descriptor: A highlighted source appeal followed by three technique-to-effect checks.

seeds.title: Inside a Plant Cell — Organelle Map
seeds.summary: Reveal the structure-function roles of five cell parts on an asset-free CSS cell diagram.
seeds.subject: science
seeds.learningObjective: Identify major plant-cell structures and explain how each contributes to cell function.
seeds.descriptor: A CSS-drawn plant cell with five progressive, resettable organelle reveals.

seeds.title: Can We Trust This Source? — Corroboration Check
seeds.summary: Evaluate a campaign claim through provenance, purpose and independent corroboration.
seeds.subject: humanities
seeds.learningObjective: Evaluate source usefulness and reliability using producer, purpose and corroborating evidence.
seeds.descriptor: A source card followed by purpose, evidence and historical-vocabulary checks.

seeds.title: Share the town budget
seeds.summary: Split a fixed town-council budget and inspect the service trade-offs created by each mix.
seeds.subject: civics
seeds.learningObjective: Explain how allocating a fixed public budget creates trade-offs between service outcomes.
seeds.descriptor: A fixed $100,000 town-council allocation with linked service meters and a trade-off check.

seeds.title: Where does the shadow fall?
seeds.summary: Predict a shadow's direction and length, then drag a lamp to test the straight-line light model.
seeds.subject: science
seeds.learningObjective: Predict and explain how a lamp's position changes a shadow's direction and length.
seeds.descriptor: A draggable lamp and fixed object in SVG with live shadow direction and length.
